messages:
Marta R: Just started my night shift — picking up active P1 for embeddings-api. Seeing ~18% 502s and tokenization lat spiking. Paging history shows repeated retries. Noted customer-facing errors from realtime-ingest.
incident-bot: Pager P1 created (embeddings-api) — severity: P1 — affected service: embeddings.redwood-prod — link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2025-482 — alert at 2901122300.
AJ P: on it. joining bridge in 2m. @Marta R do you want to stay driver or pass?
Marta R: I'll do a 15m warm handover — then I need @AJ P to take driver for the overnight window. Comms owner needed now.
Irene T: I can own comms for the next 2h. I'll post status updates and customer-facing ETA.
Leo K: quick check — pods show restarts on embeddings-worker-3, worker OOMs? kube-describe shows OOMKilled 3x in last 10m.
Samir V: logs show spike from a batch job hitting many small documents. Possibly poor batching. Sample from logs:```json
{"request_id":"r-9f3","model":"embed-v1","error":"rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = OOM"}
```
AJ P: thanks. First triage plan: 1) scale up embeddings-worker to +2 replicas (temp), 2) apply conservative batch_limit=64 via feature-flag, 3) route high-volume realtime-ingest to fallback model embed-mini-v2.
Marta R: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/embeddings-degradation. Check section "Scale-first mitigation" and "Fallback routing".
Irene T: I'm posting to #customer-status with brief note: "Degraded embeddings API — partial failures for realtime ingest. Working on rollback & scaling. Next update in 15m." :hourglass:
AJ P: command I'm running now:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deploy embeddings-worker --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference annotate deploy embeddings-worker batch_limit=64 --overwrite
```
Leo K: after scale, watch KV-cache warmup and tokenization queue. If latency persists >1200ms after scale, escalate to eng-runtime (ping @samir).
incident-bot: Incident assigned to oncall group: eng-oncall-night. Escalation window: 15m.
Marta R: handoff note: AJ will be driver after 15m. Irene is comms. I'll leave short playbook in thread.
Marta R: playbook snippet:
- driver: triage logs + scale (AJ)
- comms: updates + customer triage (Irene)
- secondary: Leo for infra checks
- escalate: Samir if OOM persists after scale and batch cap
AJ P: scaled to 6 replicas; pods coming up. Observability: 502 rate down to 9% (10m window) but tail latency still 800-1k ms for embeddings.
Irene T: posted customer note to support team and flagged priority customer "RiveryCorp" — their ingest failures are ~40% per their dashboard. I'm opening a support ticket and adding mitigation steps.
Samir V: looking at model memory — embed-v1 has recent build with changed mem footprint. Suggest revert to prior model build if OOMs continue. 
AJ P: if we revert, we need canary to avoid regression. Plan: route 20% to embed-v1-old, 80% to scaled cluster.
Marta R: ok handing over now — AJ confirmed as driver. Irene comms. Leaving these outstanding checks in thread: 1) confirm fallback routing works, 2) validate OOM root cause (code push?), 3) prepare rollback if OOMs spike after traffic normalizes.
AJ P: taking driver. will run health checks every 5m. Ping me if you see error rate bounce.
Irene T: I'll post next customer update at +15 and include workaround.
Leo K: leaving note: check node pressure in us-west-1-s2; a bad autoscaler setting caused delayed pod placement earlier. I'll follow offline with infra team.
incident-bot: Next escalation check at 2901122399 (15m).
Marta R: thanks team, switching to standby. AJ you have the bridge. Good luck :) :thumbsup:
AJ P: thanks — will update this thread with each check.
Irene T: standing by for comms updates.
